text:
Alex (Sales): Quick sync — Prospect Stratus wants to run a 2-week POC using their in-house model 'stratus-v2' + an int8 variant. Asking if we can (a) onboard that model quickly, (b) guarantee compatibility with our runtime, and (c) give a rough POC cost estimate. @Mia can you own the tech check?
Mia (Solutions Eng): On it. Quick checklist: model format, max context, KV cache behavior, supported ops for int8 quant, and license. Do we have the model artifact yet? :eyes:
Alex (Sales): They can share an s3 link to a tarball (PyTorch + tokenizer). I'll paste it once I have it.
Devon (ML Eng): Heads up — stratus-v2 uses custom rotary embeddings and a sparse attention optimization. Our runtime supports rotary, but sparse attention may need a compatibility shim. Need to inspect the graph.
Mia (Solutions Eng): If we get the artifact I can run the compatibility tool locally:
```
ri model check --input s3://stratus-poc/stratus-v2.tar.gz --format pytorch --target runtime-v2 
```
Mia (Solutions Eng): That will output op-level failures and a recommended fallback (e.g., use dense attention kernel or fallback to CPU for those ops).
Devon (ML Eng): Also note the int8 variant: we should verify activation ranges. If they used post-training static quant, we may see quality regressions; recommend a small calibration set from the customer.
Sam (Product): FYI the model isn't in our official catalog yet. For a short POC we can onboard it to a private catalog entry scoped to the customer. Need artifact checksum + license confirmation.
Jen (Security): From a security/compliance angle: we need the provenance file, a signed artifact, and clarity on any third-party weights. VPC egress rules during download are required for Private customers. Also SSO for POC console access.
Alex (Sales): They agreed to sign an NDA and provide S3 link + manifest by EOD. Can we fast-track onboarding steps and an estimated cost?
Mia (Solutions Eng): Fast-track plan: (1) run ri model check (2) if ops pass, create private catalog entry (3) run small eval for int8 quality (4) deploy to a small dedicated pool with autoscale off. Should be 48-72h if no blockers. :rocket:
Devon (ML Eng): For cost ballpark — if we provision a 1-GPU pool and run POC at ~50 reqs/s with avg 512 tokens output, expect ~300k tokens/day. Rough infra cost for 2 weeks ~= $1.2k-$2.5k (high variance if heavy evals). I'll refine after seeing perf.
Mia (Solutions Eng): Pricing note for Sales: POC discounts apply; we can offer hosted credits instead of invoicing. @Alex check with finance for deal-level credit approval.
Alex (Sales): I'll ping finance. Also customer asked about support for the int8 variant name convention — they used 'stratus-v2-quant-int8'. Is that ok?
Devon (ML Eng): Naming ok. We'll map that to a runtime variant with metadata: {"quant": "int8", "calibrated": "true/false"}. (I'll add to onboarding checklist).
Mia (Solutions Eng): If model check returns `UnsupportedOp: SparseAttention` we can try two paths: request a traced ONNX or enable our sparse compatibility layer (slower). I'll document options in the onboarding ticket.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://redwood.internal/tickets/POC-1823 — assigned to Mia, Devon, Sam.
Sam (Product): I'll prepare a private catalog template and a short runbook for the customer-facing engineer. Also add a rollback policy in case int8 quality drops.
Jen (Security): Also need to confirm KMS key policy for S3 artifact access. Alex, ask the customer to provide the key alias or we'll request temporary signed url.
Alex (Sales): Noted — I'll request signed URL + license + calibration dataset sample. ETA from customer: tomorrow morning.
Mia (Solutions Eng): Great — once I run `ri model check` I'll paste the output here. If we see <=2 op failures we can likely shim quickly. If more, escalate to runtime team. :thumbsup:
Devon (ML Eng): If the calibration set is >10k tokens we'll need a short running job to produce activation ranges; let me know and I'll allocate a spot on the lab cluster.
Alex (Sales): Perfect. Thanks team. Will update when artifacts arrive.
Mia (Solutions Eng): Quick TODOs: Alex -> upload s3 link + manifest; Jen -> KMS/SSO checklist; Devon -> prepare lab slot; Sam -> catalog template. I'll start the compatibility run when link arrives.
Sam (Product): Ping me once the check passes and I'll schedule a small canary rollout window.
Alex (Sales): closing loop — customer asked also about SLA during POC. We offer best-effort during POC but can add a 99.9 SLA for Dedicated trials (paid). I'll include that in the follow-up email.
Mia (Solutions Eng): OK. I'll paste initial `ri model check` results in this thread when done. :eyes:
